method.routeGenerator: N total HTTP routes: N-2 fillers (i = 0..N-3, shape FILLER[i % 5] with k = floor(i / 5): GET /res{k}/items, POST /res{k}/items, GET /res{k}/items/:id, PUT /res{k}/items/:id(\d+), GET /res{k}/files/:path*), then GET /static/target/leaf, then GET /late/:group/:id declared last. All buffer transport.
method.workloadOrder: for each run (fresh process; module import order reversed on even-numbered runs): for count in routeCounts: for workload in workloads: warm every router, then ROUNDS rounds of one sample per router, order alternating AB/BA per round
method.operation: resolveRoute(routes, method, path); on undefined, allowedMethods(routes, path)
method.ratio: per round, sample(B) / sample(A) with A the first router; median over all rounds of all runs
method.ci: percentile bootstrap of the median ratio, 4000 resamples, seed 10908
